Test Description: Configure GPIO inputs to trigger on falling edges and verify that interrupts are raised and cleared correctly for randomly chosen pads.
Remarks: Uses system interrupt enable for the selected GPIO source. Relies on an interrupt handler to clear a software flag. A specific SRAM address is used to stimulate edges. Pads are selected randomly without repetition.
Test Steps / Procedure:
1) Enable INTR_EN1 for the relevant GPIO interrupt source.
2) For a randomly selected pad, configure GPIO_8 (offset by pad index) for input with negative-edge interrupt enabled.
3) Enable the pad bit in gp0_intr2_intr_en1.
4) Stimulate a falling edge using the SRAM location to toggle the pad input.
5) In the interrupt handler, read GPIO_8 (offset) and verify input and raw status bits.
6) Read INTR1_INTR_STS1 and verify the group status bit for the pad.
7) Clear the interrupt in the per-pad register and verify the readback value.
8) Verify that INTR1_INTR_STS1 is cleared.
9) Clear RAW_STCR1 for the GPIO interrupt and verify it is cleared.
Validation / Acceptance Criteria:
1) Input status after the falling edge indicates the expected level → PASS.
2) Raw interrupt status bit for the pad is set upon the event → PASS.
3) Group interrupt status bit for the pad is set → PASS.
4) After clearing, the per-pad register readback matches the cleared value → PASS.
5) After clearing, the group interrupt status reads zero → PASS.
6) System raw interrupt status is cleared after the clear operation → PASS.
Hidden_Test_Description: Enables system GPIO interrupt (GPIO0 uses IRQ 87, GPIO1 uses IRQ 88), configures GPIOs 8–39 one at a time in input mode with negative-edge interrupt (write_reg(MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_8 + (pad_num*4), 0x00140000)), enables group interrupt (write_reg(MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_EN1, 1<<pad_num)), stimulates a negedge via SRAM writes at 0xA0243ffc by writing ~(1<<pad_num) followed by 0xffffffff, waits for ISR to run (int_pend cleared in ISR). In Default_IRQHandler, reads MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_8 + (pad_num*4) and checks DIN bit (rdata & 0x1) != 0, checks raw status bit (rdata & 0x2) != 0, checks group status in MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_STS1, clears by disabling MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_EN1 and writing 0x00110001 to MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_8 + (pad_num*4), verifies readback 0x00100001, verifies group clear (read 0x0 from MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_STS1), clears sysreg raw status with write_reg(MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_RAW_STCR1, LSS_SYSREG_RAW_STCR1_GPIOx_INTR) and confirms cleared, then clears GIC IRQ.
Hidden_Remarks: Conditional compilation selects IRQ 87 for GPIO0 or IRQ 88 for GPIO1. A fixed SRAM address 0xA0243ffc is used to generate pad transitions. int_pend is set before waiting and cleared in the ISR. Unique pad selection is enforced by checking prior selections.
Hidden_Test_Steps_Procedure:
1) If GPIO0 defined: GIC_EnableIRQ(87); else if GPIO1 defined: GIC_EnableIRQ(88).
2) If GPIO0: write_reg(MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_INTR_EN1, LSS_SYSREG_INTR_EN1_GPIO0_INTR); if GPIO1: write_reg(MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_INTR_EN1, LSS_SYSREG_INTR_EN1_GPIO1_INTR).
3) srand(time(NULL)); write_reg(0xA0243ffc, 0xffffffff).
4) For i from 0 to 31: select pad_num = rand() % 32; ensure unique by comparing with arr[0..i-1]; if duplicate, decrement i and continue.
5) For a new pad: arr[i] = pad_num; wr_val = 1 << pad_num; write_reg(MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_8 + (pad_num*4), 0x00140000); wait_on(50).
6) Enable group interrupt: write_reg(MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_EN1, (1 << pad_num)); wait_on(10).
7) Stimulate negedge: write_reg(0xA0243ffc, ~(wr_val)); wait_on(10); write_reg(0xA0243ffc, 0xffffffff).
8) Set int_pend = 1; while (int_pend == 0x1) { printf("Waiting for interrupt\n"); wait_on(10); }.
9) In Default_IRQHandler: wr_val = 1 << pad_num; int_pend = 0x0; rdata = read_reg(MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_8 + (pad_num*4)).
10) If ((rdata & 0x1) != 0) PASS else { printf("ERROR: DIN mismatch read_data=%0x\n", rdata); test_err++; }.
11) If ((rdata & 0x2) != 0x0) then rdata_grp = read_reg(MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_STS1); if ((rdata_grp & (1 << pad_num)) != 0) PASS else { printf("ERROR: Group Interrupt not occured\n"); test_err++; }.
12) Clear interrupt: write_reg(MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_EN1, 0x00000000); write_reg(MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_8 + (pad_num*4), 0x00110001); wait_on(2); rdata = read_reg(MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_8 + (pad_num*4)); if (rdata == 0x00100001) PASS else { printf("ERROR: Interrupt clear failed: %x\n", rdata); test_err++; }.
13) Verify group clear: rdata_grp = read_reg(MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_STS1); if (rdata_grp == 0x0) PASS else { printf("ERROR: Group Interrupt clear failed: %x\n", rdata_grp); test_err++; }.
14) If GPIO0: write_reg(MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_RAW_STCR1, LSS_SYSREG_RAW_STCR1_GPIO0_INTR); rdata = read_reg(MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_RAW_STCR1); if ((rdata & LSS_SYSREG_RAW_STCR1_GPIO0_INTR) == 0) PASS else { printf("sysreg status not cleared\n"); test_err++; }.
15) If GPIO1: write_reg(MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_RAW_STCR1, LSS_SYSREG_RAW_STCR1_GPIO1_INTR); rdata = read_reg(MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_RAW_STCR1); if ((rdata & LSS_SYSREG_RAW_STCR1_GPIO1_INTR) == 0) PASS else { printf("sysreg status not cleared\n"); test_err++; }.
16) If GPIO0: GIC_ClearIRQ(87); if GPIO1: GIC_ClearIRQ(88); finish(test_err) at end of test_case.
